newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Islamist group flogs people in Kuwait, paper says.
newsitem.headline: Islamist group flogs people in Kuwait, paper says.

text.p: An unknown Islamist group is flogging people in Kuwait for offences it says violate religious beliefs, a newspaper reported on Monday.
Al-Rai al-Aam said several people had complained to police of being snatched by the group, tried for alleged offences and flogged.
It said the group monitored victims to check if they drank alcoholic beverages or had illicit sexual relationships. Most victims received 80 lashes.
Conservative Kuwait, which bans the sale of alcoholic drinks, is studying its laws to ensure they comply with Islamic sharia law.
